scope: UI tests on local Next/Nest/PostgreSQL with checkout/status endpoints and Omise SDK/redirect mocked via CDP. No provider network or real payment.

results.name: Checkout restores no-attempt state without creating charge
Rapid duplicate clicks create one source and one payment request
Redirect returns to same invoice; URL success claim cannot mark payment paid
Refresh retrieves pending attempt without duplicate POST
Unsafe authorization URL never renders a redirect link
Payment status network/provider error is visible
Zero-net invoice has no source/charge button
